domain_shift: train fin counts 5-8 -> test fin counts 10-12 (out-of-distribution)
notes: Baselines quoted from the SIMSHIFT paper (Table 2); their numbers include UDA. Our numbers use no UDA. Primary model-selection metric is mean nRMSE (averaged over fields). Reproduce: python -m kuber.train_simshift --data <simshift> --splits <splits> --difficulty medium --geom_mode surface ; evaluate with --eval_only <ckpt>.

value_of_data.description: Same model (surface, reduced 'transfer' conditioning, no UDA), from scratch vs pretrained on the Kuber corpus then fine-tuned on SIMSHIFT. T_RMSE in Kelvin on the target domain unless noted.

stability_edge_gradient.description: Predicted / CFD |grad T| near the wall (closest 15% of nodes). 1.0 = faithful; >1 would be gradient explosion. Reproduce: python -m kuber.edge_proof --ckpt <ckpt> --data <simshift> --splits <splits> --difficulty medium.
